Satono Crown didn't show up for training, 
so while searching around worriedly for 
her...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, ...oh? Trainer, what are you 
doing in my room...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry...! To think I slacked off 
on training by dozing off!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I've been playing card games with a friend 
overseas recently. Because of the time 
zone difference, our start times always 
end up...
